text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- "Terrorists", in revenge for government offensive in Attatba area south of Algiers, massacre more than 45 villagers in Larba region south of capital; four people killed in bomb attacks in other areas south of Algiers and in western province of Bel Abbes.
- Massacre in Larba where at least 47 killed in "terrorist" raid.
- Physician Abdelaziz Ben Yahia shot dead in his clinic in eastern town of Constantine.
- More than 50 people slaughtered in Larba.
- Twenty-two villagers killed in Medea province south of Algiers.
- Government expected to announce privatisation programme of 200 state-owned enterprises.
- Security forces kill two "terrorists" including cell leader named Abu Meriem in Ksar Boukhari region, southeast of Algiers.
